name: Halberd
summary: Paired arm arc projectors and large lasers strike behind reinforced plate. Compound cooling and a fast stride favour coordinated pushes over lone duels.
lore: Early recovered Halberds reached Sarn without their weapons. Local shoulder racks kept them in service until certified emitters became available. The current service fit restores paired arm arc projectors and large lasers, compound cooling and heavier plate without changing the inherited root or its fast gait. The empty shoulder interfaces still accept local missiles. Three Halberds advancing together can choose the range and concentrate their first volley; one caught alone against a mixed battery has fewer answers.
strengths: Long-reaching paired arc and laser batteries
Fast heavy with compound cooling and no bins
weaknesses: Losing an arm removes two primary weapons
A close mixed battery can win the lone duel
